metadata.description: A suite of Claude Code plugins: house rules, a ticket-to-pull-request loop, a read-only audit of finished pull requests, and instruction-file maintenance.

plugins.name: rules
plugins.description: House rules for Claude Code sessions: one block in your CLAUDE.md, kept current, plus the Concise Plain output style.

plugins.name: loop
plugins.description: Plan, build, review and publish a bundle of tickets as one reviewed pull request per repository, resuming on the same branch when run again.

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: A read-only, adversarial audit of finished pull requests that stops at a report, with an act step that commits approved items.

plugins.name: primer
plugins.description: Project instructions in the forms Claude Code loads: a short CLAUDE.md, path-scoped rules, nested instructions and skills, with auto memory promoted into them and a hook that checks every commit.
